notes.title: Update 1.0.1 + Linux support
notes.content:
Hello all!

We have updated the game to version 1.0.1. The changes are:
[list]
    [*] Added fullscreen option in the settings menu, so that you can now toggle fullscreen mode on and off.
    [*] Added auto updating of the available games list on 'Join game' screen. The game checks for available games every 20 seconds, when the game is found, it plays a sound signal.
    [*] Added flag icon to the language selection box in the start menu and increased its font size. We hope that it should increase its visibility :)
[/list]

Also, we have added the Linux versions. I tried to do my best to find out why Linux versions don't work well with Steam integration in some cases, but please note, that there can still be bugs.

Overall, singleplayer game should work fine on Linux, but you can experience problems with multiplayer and other Steam features (achievements, leaderboards). If you'll experience such problems, please, don't hesitate to create a forum post describing your problem, and I'll try to help you.

Have a nice day,
Best regards,
NLB project team
